title: Positive, negative, or zero
instruction: Check if number is positive, negative, or zero. Print the result.
test_suite:
import io, sys

def test_prints_negative():
    _old = sys.stdout
    captured = io.StringIO()
    sys.stdout = captured
    exec(open("exercise.py").read())
    sys.stdout = _old
    output = captured.getvalue()
    assert output == 'negative\n', f"Expected negative for -3, got {output!r}"
